functional_differences.finding: 2.0/2.1 ECU appearance matches but software differs; 2.2 connector arrangement differs.
2.2 load sensing signal reaches cab ECU through double module and CAN; 2.0/2.1 direct signal.
TCM-equipped and relay-valve-equipped trailer control are separate variants.
Retarder disengagement uses different mechanisms in 2.0/2.1 and 2.2.
